title: Is Hyderabad a Good Place to Settle? Jobs, Rent, Metro and Lifestyle in 2026

seoDescription: Is Hyderabad a good place to settle in 2026? Rents by area, jobs, schools, hospitals, the metro, safety and downsides, for families and professionals.
